title: Make validateApp reject apps without an owner (libs/shared-contracts)
Pass owner (team) from apps/sub-route-reports to validateApp and ship it
Pass owner (team) from apps/sub-route-billing to validateApp, adopt the new contract and ship it
Pass owner (team) from apps/core-shell to validateApp, adopt the new contract and ship it

summary: PLAT-103 done. PR #1 (mono): validateApp in libs/shared-contracts now throws unless app.owner is a non-blank string; lib bumped to 2.0.0. Merged, CI+CD green (CD deploys nothing for libs-only changes). PR #2 (mono): core-shell passes owner 'platform', sub-route-billing 'payments', sub-route-reports 'insights' (each from its package.json team). Merged, CI+CD green, CD deployed. Assumptions: (1) sub-route-reports also calls validateApp, so I added a sub-task and updated it; (2) shared-contracts is inlined at build time, so 'release' = merge plus rebuild of consumers, and it has no registry publish; (3) owner literals are hard-coded in source because the bundlers can't read package.json; they match the team fields; (4) the two PRs are ordered: lib first, apps second, since apps only pick up the new contract by building from main after PR #1.
